name: ships/manta-thruster
description: MANTA thruster flame v2 (R4-01.A2, art bible v2 § 5.3): the KESTREL thruster's 9 × 5 four-frame flicker grammar in the MANTA's green-to-cyan engine ramp, anchor at the attachment point on its right edge. New v2-only name — the scale-1 build has no thruster for the MANTA (decision RR-1a: a new name gets no v1 stand-in).
